content: Jesudi mihiŋiye ninadi titiŋdok talii yenindidimeguk
Heleniŋ Jesu adi kwet niŋkade wooŋ Bepaŋ ninadi hatuguk. Tiŋa tubudapmaune mihiŋiŋ niŋdi indiŋ niŋguk, “Wapum, du Jondi mihiŋiye yenindidimeguk unduŋ dubo indi ninadi titiŋdok ninindidimeweŋ.”
Unduŋ yobune Jesudi yeniŋguk, “Ninadi tine kaŋ indiŋ yoyaneeŋ,

content.text: ‘Me Baŋ, du’walaŋ woho uŋgoniŋ hinek u ganintiloloŋ tinene hatuwaak.
Unduŋ doktiŋa du buŋa welenik tuwot eŋ kwet tuwot Wapumnik tinimbeŋ.
Indi me nolidi kadakaniŋ tinimbune yomhik biyemne nibuŋa dubo indi’walaŋ yomnik tumolokut-nimiluwaaŋ.

content: Unduŋ yoŋa indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Nebek hidi’walaaniŋ niŋdi noliŋiŋ’walaŋ yolineŋ timiŋ lekiŋgoŋ wooŋ indiŋ nimbek, ‘Kedem be belet yawe lufomkulitniŋ nambeŋ ala kibibo tuwaaŋ gambaat.
Me notne niŋ timiŋ busuwalak, kaŋ nu nanaŋene moŋ doktiŋa buŋa ganilat.’
Unduŋ yobeŋ kaŋ noke wondi yot maaneŋ uŋgoŋ hali indiŋ tuwot mu yobek, ‘Talik agaŋ tehekilitiŋa wapmihineye indi agaŋ deikam doktiŋa mu pilali gambit ale mede wapum mu tobeŋ.’
I nadineŋ, noliŋiŋ doktiŋa mu pilali gamdok nadiwek iŋgoŋ fiit yogigine ha-tibaakneŋ yoŋa kedem pilali nemenemekdok yobeŋ u gambek.

“Unduŋ doktiŋa indiŋ nadineŋ. Yonadi tiiŋ adi folooŋ moŋgokiiŋ doktiŋa hidi gigine tiŋa yonadiyaneeŋ. Lohi tiiŋ adi folooŋ tubumintaiŋ doktiŋa gigine tiŋa lohiyaneeŋ. Yeme foloŋ youtnadiiŋ adi yeme dilitomyemulak doktiŋa gigineeŋ yeme youtnadiyaneeŋ.
“Nebek me wapmihihinit hidi mihihikdi pisidok hanimbu miŋgembet kedem be mineŋ?
Be pupup kilikdok hanimbu maŋgitalita kedembe mineŋ?
Hidi kadakaniŋ titiŋdi wapmihihiye nanaŋe fofohi yemiiŋ iŋgoŋ oŋ, Kunum Behik adi halakapme-dapmalakdi Uŋgoniŋ Munabulidok ninadi tubune kedem hamuluwaak.”
Jesudi yabap yehikeleune meeniŋ nolidi niŋkadakagiŋ
Me niŋ adi yabapdi fomimbune mede mu yoluguk ala Jesudi yabap u keleune me u mede yoguk. Kaŋ metam adi kaŋ boho tigiŋ.
Iŋgoŋ nolidi yogiŋ, “Me i yabap heki’walaŋ wapumhik, Belisibudi tubulodaune yabap yeniŋkelekuyaulak.”
Unduŋ yogiŋ kaŋ metam noliyeŋ indiŋ niŋgiŋ, “Du Bepaŋ’walaaniŋ biyagoŋ nobu foweŋ kaŋ kudi neeŋ tubune saŋiniŋge kanim.”

Iŋgoŋ Jesu adi nadinadihik u kanadiŋa indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Kwet wapum niŋ adi utawaaŋ bop molomolom tiŋa mindobuneŋ kaŋ kwet u pilap kadakawek. Be hekinolit niŋ adi daneeŋ molomolom hatiŋa mindobu tubune lekiŋgoŋhik foloŋ utawa utawa hali kadakawek.
“Hidi nu Belisibudi saŋiniŋ nambune yabap yehikelelat yoiŋ, iŋgoŋ Sadaŋ’walaŋ mebopdi utawaaŋ bop lufom tiŋa mindobu tubune adi’walaŋ kwanai deti saŋiniŋnit halek?
Ale nu undugoŋ nobu tilit kaŋ me hidut hatiiŋ adi dediŋ tiŋa yehikeleiŋ? Me hidut hatiiŋdi hidi yalaŋ yoiŋ u tubudakalelak.
Nu Bepaŋ’walaŋ saŋiniŋŋiŋ gineŋ nobu yabap heki yehikelelit kaŋ hidi Bepaŋ’walaŋ hebeŋ foloŋ Hatihati Kobulidi agaŋ hehitubu-dulalak u agaŋ mintadakalelak.
“Me fafaŋeniŋ niŋdi mik diniŋ bomboŋ tiulidokooŋ yoli kadoko fafaŋeŋ tilakneŋ u bomboŋŋiŋ kedem ilimiiŋ,
iŋgoŋ me niŋ fafaŋeŋ hinek wondi bulakneŋ me u ulaŋa mik bomboŋŋiŋ moŋgola nemek noli kubonelak u daneeŋ me noliŋiye yemulak.
“Nebek niŋ nu menot mu tinamulak adi yadi mik tinamulak, be nebek niŋ nu mu nehitubu-lodaaŋ kwanaine kadokolak adi yadi yehitubu-pupuhene tilak.”
Wele tubutakale tikaaŋ Jesu mu bikabudok

Unduŋ yoŋa tomboyoula indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Yabap adi me niŋ weleŋ gineniŋ labuŋa wooŋ kwet ime moŋ gineŋ kwet fiileŋ hakula titiŋdok kwet lohitaulak. Lohitawooŋ moŋ lohikaaŋ indiŋ yolak, ‘Kotigoŋ udaneeŋ yotnede wit.’
“Unduŋ yoŋa kotigoŋ udaneeŋ wooŋ kalune yot yohomuŋ tiŋa tutumbanit u kalak.
Tiŋa kotigoŋ wooŋ yabap kadakahi hinek 7 nimaaŋ yanagila buŋa uŋgoŋ noŋgoŋ itowiiŋ. Unduŋ tubune me u koom yabap kubugoŋdi fomimbu hatiguk undiniŋ u wabiŋa agaŋ kisaŋ hinek kadakalak.”
Jesudi mede unduŋ yobune tam niŋ metam bop gineŋ uŋgoŋ pilali indiŋ yoguk, “Tam gehitubu-mintaaŋ gabudokooŋ nom gamguk adi Bepaŋdi kaune utumba tilak.”
Unduŋ yoguk kaŋ Jesudibo indiŋ yoguk, “U kedem yolaŋ ala niŋ indiŋ, metam Bepaŋ medeŋiŋ nadiŋa tagimneiŋ adi Bepaŋdi yabunadiune utumba hinek tilak.”
Meeniŋ mohok Jesudi Bepaŋ’walaŋ kudi tubune kakaŋdok yogigine tigiŋ
Metam feedi bopnegiŋ kaŋ tomboyoula indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Metam kobuhi hidi kadakaniŋ titiŋdigoŋ kunum gineniŋ kudi titiŋdok naniiŋ. Iŋgoŋ kudi gitipmuŋ nemoŋ.
Jonadi Niniwehidok kudi tiyemguk unduŋ Me Kobumuŋ adi metam kobuhi kudi tiyembaak kaŋ kaneeŋ.

“Sebahi’walaŋ Tam Wapme loloŋnit adi yolikweli biŋa pilali Mapme Solomondi mede nadisuŋa nadidakalenit yoguk u nadiwene uguk. Ale indiŋ hanimbe nadineŋ. Kobuk hebehik foloŋ yatak adi Solomon kalakapme tilak doktiŋa Bepaŋ’walaŋ nai wapum foloŋ Sebahi’walaŋ Tam Wapme adi pilali metam kobuhi hidi’walaŋ mebihik yobihilune kadakaniŋhik diniŋ kibikoŋ beneeŋ.
“Niniwehi adi Jonadi yenimbune kadakaniŋhik sigilulum timiŋgiŋ. Eŋ kobuk yuku hidut yatak yoŋ adi Jonadok tuwot moŋ, ala nai wapum foloŋ metam kobuhi hidi mede gineŋ hapmeneeŋ.
“Nebek niŋdi kamaŋ galiŋa kamehebi mu tilak, tobo galiŋa foloniŋgoŋ kameu ila hautaune metamdi hauta u kaŋ yopmaŋ foiŋ.
Dauhik adi foloohik diniŋ hauta, ala dauhikdi kedem halune foloohikdi hauta gineŋ hatibetik eŋ dauhikdi sipmakaune foloohik adi mambip gineŋ hatibetik.
Unduŋ doktiŋa hautahik welehik gineŋ hatak u mambip tibaakneŋ doktiŋa nadinadiŋale hatiyaneeŋ.
Tiŋa welehik be sigihik gineŋ mambip nemu haletik adi foloohik wanaŋ hogok hautadapmawetik. U kamaŋdi galiu hautagamulak undiniŋ hautawetik.”
Bepaŋ’walaŋ mede adi manikdi hogok mu yodok
Jesu adi mede yodapmaune Falisi niŋdi nanaŋe noŋgoŋ nanaŋdok yoŋa niŋa nagila ugumuk. Wooŋ nanaŋe nanaŋdok ikumuk,
ilaŋa Jesudi kohoŋ mu youtela ikuk kaŋ Falisidi kaŋ boho tubune niŋguk,
“Falisi heki hidi adi maliŋ be ime utnaŋdok tout u sigihineŋ hogok youtewalandaiŋ, kaŋ maaneŋkade adi kadakaniŋ titiŋhikdi fotokooŋ hatak.
Kaulehi hidi, Bepaŋ nemek sigiŋ tuguk-digoŋ maaneŋ mube tuguk?
Unduŋ doktiŋa nanaŋe ime maliŋhik gineŋ ikiiŋ u fiyewakahidok yembune welehik walandawek.

“Hidige! Falisi heki, habunadiwe tuwot mu tilak! Hidi adi nemenemek-kabe diniyetiiŋ u faki Bepaŋdok kedem miiŋ, iŋgoŋ hidi welehikdi Bepaŋ mu kahileiŋ, tiŋa metam fiyewakahi’walaŋ malabumuŋ mintalak u mu yehitubu-lodaaŋ tubudidimeiŋ. Yodoko Mede yoŋ adi biyabu mu titiŋdok. Tiŋa noli dibek feŋ yehikeleiŋ u maaŋ kedem yehikeleeŋ titiŋdok, iŋgoŋ niŋ takaliŋa tiŋa niŋ mu bibiŋdok.
“Hidige! Falisi heki, habunadiwe tuwot mu tilak! Hidi adi bopyotneŋ me wohiyenit’walaŋ pop foloŋ iitdok hogok nadiiŋ tiŋa yowawaliweŋ haniutumbaaŋ habugikiŋgoŋ tihamdok nadiiŋ.
Hidi adi bom kumuhi yehiweneeŋ fek mu tiiŋ kaŋ metamdi sithik foloŋ uŋgoŋ yaliŋa yawiiŋ undihi. Unduŋ doktiŋa Bepaŋ namanda foloŋ nemek undihi wa geŋgeŋhinit.”
Unduŋ yobune me Yodoko Mede hinale niŋdi niŋguk, “Hinale, du unduŋ yoŋa indi maaŋ niniŋtifo tilaŋ.”

Unduŋ niŋguk kaŋ Jesudibo yoguk, “Hidige! Yodoko Mede hinale heki, habunadiwe tuwot mu tilak! Hidi adi metam Yodoko Mede malabumuŋ hinek yembune adi kwanaimiŋ tiiŋ kaŋ hidi yehitubu-lodadok kohohik mu kihiwakiiŋ.
Hidi papahiyedi polofet hogohogok widihikumuŋgiŋ kaŋ hidi agaŋ yabukiyondaaŋ sithik momooŋgoŋ tutumbaiŋ.
Unduŋ tiŋa papahiye’walaŋ kadakaniŋ u kaune utumba tilak. Adi widihikumuŋ tigiŋ kaŋ hidi sithik yabu-utumba tiiŋ.
“Bepaŋdi u agaŋ nadidakaleeŋ indiŋ yoguk, ‘Nu polofet be aposel aditok yeniŋkule uune noli widihikumuneeŋ eŋ noli widihi yehikele tineeŋ.’
Unduŋ doktiŋa polofet hogohogok kwet tububihikukneniŋgoŋ widihikumuŋgiŋ wondok kibikoŋ metam kobuhi hidi hekineeŋ.

Tububihila Abel’walaaniŋ labugelabuge Sakaliya Siloŋyot maaneŋ alta eŋ Yotmaaŋ Uŋgoniŋ lekiŋgoŋhik foloŋ ulukumuŋgiŋ. Biyagoŋ hinek hanilat. Metam kobuhi hidi, polofet kumuŋgiŋ hogohogok adi’walaŋ naŋgathik diniŋ kibikoŋ hekineeŋ.

“Hidige! Yodoko Mede hinale heki, habunadiwe tuwot mu tilak! Hidi metamdi Yodoko Mede nadidakaledok talik u yolomti tiiŋ. Unduŋ tiŋa hidi hide mu foiŋ tiŋa metam nolidi fone nadiiŋ iŋgoŋ hidi kamehep tiyemiiŋ.”
Jesu adi unduŋ yoŋa yot u bikabuŋa ulune nai uŋaniŋgoŋ Yodoko Mede hinale tiŋa Falisi heki adi tububihila mik timiŋa yonadi fee timimbune
maŋgoŋ mede fai niŋ yobune nadiŋa nagila mede gineŋ kameŋdok yoŋa kakuwali keleyawagiŋ.
